{{Top|leg}}
The '''cybernetic interface jack''' was used by native [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzans]], along with an [[Attanni]], to share feelings and emotions. [[Gold/Legends|Gold]]-plated and located below the ear, the interface jack allowed for a direct connection to the emotion centers of the brain.

About [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], and [[Manaroo/Legends|Manaroo]], an Aruzan tech-empath, shared their love for each other using their cybernetic interface jacks and an Attanni. Marriage occurred a short time later.
